profile.headline: Frontend Web Developer | Vue.js, Nuxt, TypeScript, Tailwind
profile.summary: As a Frontend Web Developer, I am passionate about creating captivating web experiences that are engaging and performant. I have over 12 years of web development experience, working with various web technologies like Vue.js, Nuxt, Tailwind, and TypeScript. Currently, I work as a Frontend Web Developer, where I am looking to collaborate with designers, developers, and clients to deliver high-quality web solutions. Previously, I was a Senior Web Developer at FINE, A Brand Agency, where I led and supported various web development projects for clients across different industries and also where I honed my skills and learned from a talented team of web professionals. I have a Bachelor of Applied Science in New Media Communications from Oregon State University. I am always eager to learn new skills, explore new challenges, and contribute to the web development community. My goal is to create web experiences that are accessible, responsive, and innovative.

positions.description: Previously worked as a freelance front-end developer in the Portland area. Focused on small to medium sized projects with an emphasis on Wordpress, HTML5, responsive development, CSS3, and jQuery. Clients/collaborators so far have included: Copious, Pixelspoke, Substance, Harlo Interactive, OVO, Aisle7 and R West.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Lead web developer for Alliance Global, technology department. Responsibilities included all aspects of front-end and back-end development cycles as well as providing technical guidance on all projects. Relied upon to push the company forward in terms of web technologies and modern web development techniques/tools. Client list included: Kate Somerville, Jabbawockeez, Sony, JAFRA Cosmetics, Romik, KC HiLites, Icon Vehicle Dynamics, Petrol Advertising, and Vintage Wine Merchants.

positions.title: Front-end Web Developer
positions.description: Hired to work on both internal and external websites within the Southern California Kaiser Permanente network. Focused on developing standards compliant, cross-browser compatible sites as well as working with several different web technologies including JavaScript, ASP, and Flash.

positions.title: Front-end Web Developer
positions.description: Worked as a freelance web developer for various clients/projects. Mainly worked on developing and creating custom Wordpress sites. These clients/agencies included: Cubed Interactive, The Daily Brand Group, Blind Mice Media, and Eat.Sleep.Work. For most projects I was in charge of slicing up design mockups, creating the site structure/layout, as well as implementing site functionality and customizing content management platforms.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Front-End Development · CMS · HTML 5 · WordPress

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Turned full-site design mockups into standards compliant sites and focused on building sites on top of Wordpress platform to meet clients. Aided in getting company off the ground and back into developing sites for clients.
